metadata.Name: JDocQA
metadata.Description: JDocQA is a Japanese Document Question Answering dataset for generative language models.
Provider: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: JDocQA: Japanese Document Question Answering Dataset for Generative Language Models
metadata.Venue Title: The 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: Document question answering is a task of question answering on given documents such as reports, slides, pamphlets, and websites. This is known as a quite challenging task because it requires not only text understanding but also understanding of figures and tables, and hence visual question answering (VQA) methods are often examined in addition to textual approaches. We introduce Japanese Document Question Answering (JDocQA), a large-scale document-based QA dataset, essentially requiring both visual and textual information to answer questions, which comprises 5,504 documents in PDF format and annotated 11,600 question-and-answer instances in Japanese.
